description: This file defines the ShoppingCartEvents class, which handles various servlet-like events/actions related to shopping cart operations within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for adding/removing products, applying promotions, updating cart items, managing parties associated with the order, setting order metadata (like agreement, currency, name, PO number), initializing orders, and handling promotional and configuration logic.

classes.name: ShoppingCartEvents
classes.description: Handles all shopping cart related events and actions within the OFBiz framework, such as adding/removing items, applying promotions, managing parties, and initializing orders.

methods.name: addProductPromoCode
methods.description: Adds a promotional code to the shopping cart.

methods.name: removePromotion
methods.description: Removes a promotion from the shopping cart based on promo code ID.

methods.name: addItemGroup
methods.description: Creates and adds an item group to the shopping cart.

methods.name: addCartItemToGroup
methods.description: Associates a cart item with a specified item group.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the shopping cart, handling configurations, virtual products, rental info, etc.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items from a previous order into the current cart.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds all products in a category according to quantities specified in request parameters.

methods.name: quickInitPurchaseOrder
methods.description: Initializes a purchase order quickly with selected supplier information.

methods.name: quickCheckoutOrderWithDefaultOptions
methods.description: Sets default checkout options for fast order completion.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirements set for products in bulk to the cart.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds default products from a category to the cart.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates quantities or attributes of items in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Empties the shopping cart but retains the cart object.

methods.name: destroyCart
methods.description: Completely removes the cart and related session attributes.

methods.name: getCartObject
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ShoppingCart object, optionally with specified locale and currency.

methods.name: switchCurrentCartObject
methods.description: Switches the current shopping cart in session to another, managing multiple carts.

methods.name: clearCartFromList
methods.description: Removes a cart from the list of multiple carts stored in session.

methods.name: keepCartUpdated
methods.description: Ensures cart's user login, locale, and currency info is current and synchronized.

methods.name: setDesiredAlternateGwpProductId
methods.description: Selects an alternate GWP for promotional gifts in the cart.

methods.name: addAdditionalParty
methods.description: Associates an additional party (e.g., customer, vendor) with the order.

methods.name: removeAdditionalParty
methods.description: Removes an associated party from the order.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Translates the result map from cart helper methods into error or success messages and response codes.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates an agreement with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the shopping cart.

methods.name: setOrderName
methods.description: Sets the order name for the shopping cart.

methods.name: setPoNumber
methods.description: Sets the purchase order number for the cart.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds a term to the order.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds an order term to the shopping cart based on provided parameters, including term type, value, days, description, etc.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the shopping cart using an index parameter.

methods.name: loadCartFromShoppingList
methods.description: Initializes the shopping cart with items from a specified shopping list.

methods.name: loadCartFromQuote
methods.description: Initializes the shopping cart with items from a specified quote.

methods.name: loadCartFromOrder
methods.description: Initializes the shopping cart with items from an existing order, optionally creating adjustments and removing old adjustments.

methods.name: createQuoteFromCart
methods.description: Creates a quote from the current cart, optionally destroys the cart after creation.

methods.name: createCustRequestFromCart
methods.description: Creates a customer request based on the cart, with optional cart destruction.

methods.name: initializeOrderEntry
methods.description: Initializes the order entry process, setting store, party, order type, permissions, and other attributes.

methods.name: routeOrderEntry
methods.description: Routes to the next step in order entry depending on session and request state.

methods.name: doManualPromotions
methods.description: Applies manually selected promotions to the cart based on request parameters.

methods.name: bulkAddProducts
methods.description: Bulk adds products to the cart from form parameters, handling quantities, amounts, and item attributes.

methods.name: setOrderCurrencyAgreementShipDates
methods.description: Sets order currency, agreement, shipping dates, order ID, order name, PO number based on parameters.

methods.name: getConfigDetailsEvent
methods.description: Fetches and populates product configuration details, total price, and stores wrapper info.

methods.name: bulkAddProductsInApprovedOrder
methods.description: Bulk adds products to an approved order, handling quantities, delivery dates, and order-specific logic.
